note: Selective assignment (R+D.md §12.7; doc/architecture/selection.md). Named by $AT_SELECTION; absent, every task fans out to every capable peer and the prober keeps its deterministic choice. k is the MEAN number of peers a task goes to (Bernoulli inclusion for k > 1); null fans out. floor is the least probability any eligible peer is drawn with, after the required_tier gate.

probe.note: present: a directed probe's target is drawn over every capable peer, weighted by UCB1 bonuses, instead of the prober's argmax

demo.query.note: a routine read: one peer per task is enough, and exploration is cheap

demo.command-issue.note: never selected; full fan-out, so every capable peer still sees command-class work

demo.thermal-forecast.note: two forecasts per task on average; a floor of 0 means a peer the weights leave out is never explored
